headline: Referral-bonus task is well-posed: the only in-progress referral is a Silver Rewards Card and its doc gives a single $750 spend requirement.
solution_check: Verified the user (gold[0] fields equal db users[86e92f639e]), listed referrals: 16 rows, only f2a3b4c5d6789012 is IN_PROGRESS (Silver Rewards Card, 11/13/2025, the most recent). doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_011: "The referred person must be approved and spend at least $750 within 60 days". The user then calls submit_transaction(friend_user_5839, "Silver Rewards Card", "Best Buy", 750, "Shopping"), matching gold[1]. submit_transaction formats amount with :.2f in both the id seed and the record, so 750 vs 750.0 hash identically.
prior_note: Prior labelled this Minor but named no defect ("No real issue; uniquely determined"); re-derivation agrees there is no defect, so it is None now.
notes: friend_user_5839 has no rows in any db.json table, although the persona says the friend 'made some transactions'; an agent that looks them up sees none, which still leads to the full $750 amount. Weekly cap (doc_..._(general)_002, 2 bonuses per rolling 7 days): only one COMPLETE referral (11/11/2025) falls in the 7 days before 11/14, so the cap is not hit. The Silver doc's "up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year" could be misread as cross-card (the user has 8 COMPLETE referrals across cards in 2025, 1 of them Silver); this only matters if an agent refuses to quote the $750, and the doc scopes it to the Silver program. The referrer has no credit_card_accounts rows (irrelevant to grading). Grading-model facts confirmed in snapshot: evaluator_env replays gold and compares get_db_hash/get_user_db_hash; _derive_read_log_allowlist only adds call_discoverable_agent_tool names; call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool parse JSON with parse_int=float; get_now() = 2025-11-14 03:40:00.
